# Learning Setup

## Prerequisites {.theory-slide}

::: {.theory-card}
- Telecommunication systems and networks fundamentals.
- Digital transmission and mobile communications.
- Radio propagation and spectrum basics.
- Elementary network dimensioning and traffic analysis.
- Basic use of calculation, simulation, or programming tools.
:::

## Learning Method {.theory-slide}

::: {.theory-card}
- Theoretical lectures for models and decision criteria.
- Case analysis to connect concepts to real deployments.
- Practical sessions around an integrative network design project.
- Comparative perspective across terrestrial and satellite cases.
:::

## Integrative Project {.use-case-slide}

::: {.use-case-card}
Students define a scenario, dimension the access layer, design transport, add economic and regulatory criteria, and defend the result in a final presentation.

### Milestones

- CP1: Scenario and requirements.
- CP2: Access design.
- CP3: Transport and feasibility.
- CP4: Integration and deployment strategy.
:::
